name: Vship
description: Vship is a GPU-accelerated library for computing perceptual video quality metrics, SSIMULACRA2, Butteraugli, and CVVDP, significantly faster than CPU-based tools. It supports Vulkan, CUDA, and HIP, and ships with FFVship, a CLI for encoder developers who want faster, more accurate quality tuning than PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF provide.
